description: We are building a space mission design game(beginners)
summary:
Space Mission Control is an interactive educational game that allows users to design, plan, and simulate a space exploration mission. Players can select destinations such as the Moon, Mars, and Europa, choose spacecraft and mission equipment, and make decisions about propulsion, launch vehicles, power, communications, and science instruments.

The game includes mission stages, resource management, flight control, and unexpected emergencies. Players must manage resources such as fuel, energy, oxygen, water, and food while trying to complete their mission successfully.

The main aim is to make space mission planning easier to understand and more engaging for students and beginners. Through interactive decisions and simulation, users can learn about the challenges involved in planning and managing a space exploration mission.
details:
About the Project

Space Mission Control is a browser-based educational game designed to introduce users to the basic concepts of space mission planning and simulation.

How It Works

Users can select a destination such as the Moon, Mars, or Europa. They can configure mission options, including spacecraft, propulsion systems, launch vehicles, power systems, communication systems, and science instruments.

The game provides four main sections:

1. Design Mission: Select the destination and configure the mission.
2. Flight Control: Follow the different stages of the simulated mission.
3. Resources: Monitor fuel, energy, oxygen, water, food, and crew health.
4. Mission Report: Review the mission outcome and performance.

Users must make decisions, manage resources, and respond to unexpected mission emergencies.

Benefits and Impact

The project makes space exploration concepts easier to understand through interactive learning. It encourages students to think about engineering decisions, resource management, problem-solving, and the challenges of space exploration.

Technology Used

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- GitHub Pages for website hosting

The project combines mission design, resource management, flight simulation, and emergency decision-making in one browser-based educational game.

Use of AI Assistance

ChatGPT was used as an AI assistance tool during development to help generate and improve parts of the HTML, CSS, JavaScript code and project text. The project was reviewed and tested by the project creator.
